description: LinkedIn publishes run dates, impressions and targeting only on a subset of creatives. Search is the SERP card; source is native|extended. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

company.description: Alias of q — advertiser / account owner name.

companyId.description: LinkedIn numeric company id for exact advertiser match.

country.description: Single ISO country code. Default US. Ignored when countries is set.

endDate.description: Custom range end YYYY-MM-DD (use with startDate).

keyword.description: Optional keyword filter on ad creative copy.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 20, max 200). Flat 2 credits per call on the native path; the extended fallback bills ~3.5 credits per returned ad. Response `source` is native or extended so you can see which price applied.

q.description: Advertiser / account owner name (min 2 when used). Provide q/company, keyword, or companyId.

startDate.description: Custom range start YYYY-MM-DD (use with endDate).

name: linkedin_ad_library_search_ads
title: LinkedIn Ad Library Search
